metadata.description: Agent skills for EU EmpCo green claims: screen material for greenwashing risk and write lower-risk claims

plugins.name: empco-skills
plugins.description: Two skills for EU EmpCo green claims: empco-screener finds and risk-classifies environmental and social claims in a webpage, PDF, ad, or pasted copy; empco-claim-writer turns a fact, an aspiration, or a flagged claim into lower-risk directions with the evidence each one needs
